name: Dimensional Storekeeper
source:
A story about a zombie-like interdimensional shopkeeper and the weird people and creatures he picks up.

[Edited from [url=https://waywardvoidgod.itch.io/dimensional-store-keeper]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲的是一位形似丧尸、穿行于不同次元的店主，以及一路上被他捡回来的怪人与生物。
